evals.name: rawaq-full-build
evals.prompt: We just signed a new client, Rawaq Coffee Roasters (Riyadh specialty coffee). Their brand files are in clients/rawaq/input (guidelines PDF, logos, fonts). Build their design system so our other agents can produce on-brand work from it.
evals.expected_output: A complete design system in clients/rawaq/design-system: all 8 colours with correct HEX and Arabic names, Saffron conflict (#E3A33B vs #E4A23C) flagged with #E3A33B chosen, Charcoal #1F1B18 found, logo variants with backgrounds/min sizes/clear space, misuse rules recovered from the image-only page, bilingual type scale, proposals (spacing/radii/shadow) clearly marked, machine-readable tokens.
